usageRules: Use components from @frontend-ai-context-kit/ui before creating custom controls.
Prefer Button for actions, Input and Select for forms, Modal for focused blocking decisions, Tabs for related panels, and Card for grouped content.
Keep primary Button usage limited to the main action in the current workflow section.
Always provide labels for Input and Select unless an adjacent visible label already exists.
Use error props for validation feedback instead of rendering ad hoc red text.
Use Modal only for focused tasks that require user attention; avoid nesting modals.
Use Card for repeated summaries and metadata, not as a generic page section wrapper.
When generating examples, include imports, realistic state handling, and accessible labels.

components.name: Button
components.description: Action component for primary flows, secondary actions, destructive operations, and low-emphasis controls.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis of the action. Use primary once per workflow section.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height and horizontal padding.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button while an async action is running.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Expands the button to fill the width of its parent container.

props.name: children
props.description: Button content. Prefer concise labels such as "Save changes".

examples.title: Primary action
examples.description: Use a primary button for the main action in a form or focused workflow.

examples.title: Loading state
examples.description: Set isLoading while an async mutation is pending so duplicate submits are blocked.

examples.title: Destructive action
examples.description: Use the danger variant only for irreversible or high-risk actions.

components.name: Card
components.description: Contained surface for grouped content, component summaries, metadata, and small dashboards.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional card title rendered in the header.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Optional supporting text below the title.

props.name: actions
props.description: Header action area, typically a button or compact link.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the card container.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner spacing density.

props.name: children
props.description: Main card content.

examples.title: Component summary card
examples.description: Use Card to group component metadata in documentation and search results.
examples.code: Primary action component with loading and destructive states.

examples.title: Interactive card
examples.description: Use the interactive variant only when the whole card is clickable.
examples.code: Text field wrapper with validation messaging.

examples.title: Card with actions
examples.description: Use actions for contextual commands without crowding the main content.
examples.code:
Copy}>

Prefer existing UI primitives before creating new controls.

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input wrapper with label, description, validation message, and consistent sizing.

props.name: label
props.description: Human-readable field label. It is visually associated with the input.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting copy shown below the control when there is no error.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. When present, the input is marked invalid.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height and text sizing.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Expands the input wrapper and control to fill the parent width.

examples.title: Basic field
examples.description: Use label and description to explain what data the user should enter.
examples.code: <Input label="Project name" name="projectName" description="Shown in dashboards and docs." />

examples.title: Validation state
examples.description: Pass error to mark the field invalid and replace helper text with feedback.
examples.code: <Input label="Repository URL" error="Enter a valid GitHub URL." />

examples.title: Full-width form row
examples.description: Use fullWidth when the field sits in a responsive form layout.

components.name: Modal
components.description: Dialog surface for focused decisions, short forms, confirmations, and contextual details.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Controls whether the dialog is rendered.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog title announced by assistive technologies.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting text shown under the title.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the user asks to close the modal.

props.name: children
props.description: Dialog body content. Keep it focused and short.

props.name: footer
props.description: Optional footer actions, usually cancel and confirm buttons.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum modal width.

props.name: closeOnBackdrop
props.description: Whether clicking the backdrop should call onClose.

examples.title: Confirmation dialog
examples.description: Use Modal for focused confirmation flows with explicit cancel and confirm actions.

examples.title: Form modal
examples.description: Pair Modal with Input and Select for short forms that do not need a full page.
examples.code:
<Modal isOpen={isOpen} title="Create token" onClose={closeModal}>
  <Input fullWidth label="Token name" />
</Modal>

components.name: Select
components.description: Native select wrapper for compact choice fields with label, helper copy, and validation state.

props.name: label
props.description: Human-readable field label.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder option shown before a value is selected.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text shown below the control when there is no error.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. When present, the select is marked invalid.

props.name: options
props.description: Available options. Keep labels short and scannable.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height and text sizing.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Expands the select wrapper and control to fill the parent width.

examples.title: Basic select
examples.description: Use Select for short lists where native keyboard and mobile behavior is enough.
examples.code:
<Select
  label="Component status"
  placeholder="Choose status"
  options={[
    { label: 'Stable', value: 'stable' },
    { label: 'Experimental', value: 'experimental' }
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Validation state
examples.description: Pass error to make the invalid state explicit and accessible.
examples.code: <Select label="Owner team" error="Select a team before publishing." options={teams} />

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Navigation pattern for switching between related panels without leaving the current page.

props.name: items
props.description: Collection of tabs and panels.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled active tab id. Use with onChange.

props.name: defaultActiveId
props.description: Initial tab id for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the active tab changes.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the tab list.

examples.title: Documentation tabs
examples.description: Use Tabs when component docs need API, examples, and rules in one focused view.
examples.code:
<Tabs
  items={[
    { id: 'api', label: 'API', content: <PropsTable /> },
    { id: 'examples', label: 'Examples', content: <Examples /> },
    { id: 'rules', label: 'Usage rules', content: <UsageRules /> }
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Controlled tab state
examples.description: Use activeId and onChange when the selected tab is stored in URL or app state.
